title_zh: Fun time — 第8节可背诵讲义
body_en: Clubs after school can be fun and useful. You may join music, sports, or a reading group. Practice a little every week and you will improve. If you lose a match, learn one skill and try again. Fun grows when you help a new member feel welcome.
body_zh: 课后社团既好玩又有用。你可以参加音乐、运动或阅读小组。每周练一点就会进步。若比赛输了，学一项技能再试。帮助新成员感到受欢迎时，乐趣会增长。
